name: Nebaioth
overview: Nebaioth is a male figure known as the firstborn son of Ishmael, belonging to the tribe named after him. His place in Scripture is primarily defined by his lineage as Ishmael's eldest son, marking him as a significant patriarchal figure within his tribal context.
namesAndTitles: The name Nebaioth appears as a proper name in the biblical record, with no specific meaning or divine origin indicated. It is presented plainly without additional titles or meanings attached.
familyAndRelationships: Nebaioth is explicitly identified as the son of Ishmael. He is also inferred to be the brother of Mahalath, suggesting a familial connection within Ishmael's descendants. Scripture does not record further family relationships beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Nebaioth's significance lies in his role as the firstborn son of Ishmael, who himself is a key figure in biblical history. As the progenitor of a tribe bearing his name, Nebaioth represents the continuation of Ishmael's lineage, which holds an important place in the broader narrative of God's dealings with the descendants of Abraham.
